blocks.text: The armor imagery in verse 17 may reuse scriptural pictures of a divine warrior and of peace. A later use of similar imagery places it alongside prayer and truthful witness. This proposed connection is interpretive and disputed, but it can draw attention to the way Isaiah presents righteousness and salvation as God’s own equipment.

The Great Isaiah Scroll preserves an almost complete witness to all sixty-six chapters of Isaiah. It broadly aligns with the Masoretic tradition while also containing many spelling and substantive differences; other Isaiah manuscripts and interpretive writings from Qumran show that the book was actively copied and interpreted.
